summary: Beaver Butte on the Warm Springs Reservation (Wasco Co., OR): tent camp 1928, 16-ft L-4 tower 1931, gone by 1967; no source describes the site today.

facts.status_note: Gone by 1967 per the Former Fire Lookout Sites register; no source read describes the site today

staffing.status: staffed in July 1928 (emergency lookout) and summer 1950 (James Beima); no later staffing in the sources read

access.note: Register says the site is administered by the Warm Springs Indian Reservation; no source read states visiting rules

facts.agency: Warm Springs Indian Reservation (Former Fire Lookout Sites); Mt. Hood National Forest and Warm Springs Indian Reservation (firelookout.com)

events.note: Tent camp built on the site (register description)

January 10, 1928 letter: a telephone line had been built to North Pinhead the year before; material on hand for a line to Beaver Butte that year; both points to be occupied only during high fire hazard
Emergency lookout reported a fire on July 17, 1928 at the spot of a May lightning fire on Beaver Creek; it appears to have been a holdover and stayed within a one-eighth-acre fire line
Emergency lookout in use in July 1928 (quoted report)
16-foot pole L-4 tower replaced the tent camp
James Beima, assistant coach at Madras Union High School, spent the summer as fire lookout (Bend Bulletin item quoted on the page)
Registered August 17, 2010; nominated by Ray Kresek

notes_for_editor: Brief record checked: status gone, elevation (1,544 m), agency and 2010 registration all match the register. No corrections. The 1928 fire, 1928 letter and 1950 lookout come from one weebly page each, so they carry the medium rating. Height 4.9 m is converted from the 16-foot figure, assuming it is tower height, as firelookout.com's wording suggests. Access level 'permission' is carried from the existing record; the register names the reservation as administrator but no source read states visiting rules, so it needs a check before publication. Do not confuse with the Beaver Butte on the Idaho Forest Lookouts page (idaholookouts.weebly.com), a different tower. The Forest Lookouts page's 'Removed' entry gives no date. No photo URLs recorded. Fact-check 2026-10-09: the January 1928 letter is now described as material on hand for a line, not a line that would be built. Evidence quotes added for the Wasco County location, the May 24 and July 17 dates, the Bend Bulletin item and the January 10, 1928 letter date.
